versions.changelog: Drop the version pin from the install line. It named 0.1.2 — the release whose binary misreports its own version — and bought nothing: a global install runs lifecycle scripts either way, and transitive dependencies still float. Unpinned matches the project README and always resolves the current release.

- Initial release of the orca-replay skill.
- Answers questions about past agent runs using their recordings instead of memory.
- Supports replaying or forking past runs to reproduce or investigate failures.
- Integrates with the `orcareplay` npm package and requires at least one recorded run.
- Distinguishes between recorded and inferred events, reporting each appropriately.
- Implements safeguards for replays, ensuring actions outside the working tree only proceed with user approval.
